correctness.rationale: For n>=3 the rank-(n-1) nilpotent Jordan shift forces the e-component f of D(V) to vanish. Every derivation is D(e)=ae+u and D|_V=aH+p(N) since the centralizer of N is k[N]. Idempotence gives a in {0,1}, B^2=B and (aI+B-I)u=0. If a=0, the local ring k[t]/(t^n) has only idempotents 0 and 1. If a=1, consecutive diagonal entries force characteristic two; in characteristic two odd superdiagonal coefficients of p(N) are free and b_{2j}=b_j^2. Rank(B) is the number of 1 diagonal entries because B is a projection; u lies in ker B. Counting choices gives all three parity-dependent exact polynomials. The explicit D(e)=e,D(v_i)=(i-1)v_i has nonabelian image in char2 since [e,v2]=v3 not in image. Independently enumerated char2 derivation matrices by parameter search and directly tested D^2=D: n=3 {0:1,2:8,3:12}, n=4 {0:1,3:32,4:16}. Nonprime fields are treated by algebraic field equations, not inferred solely from prime tests.

originality.rationale: Avetisyan describes general derivation blocks for almost-Abelian Lie algebras, which supply the linear stage but not the nonlinear idempotent equation or its characteristic-two ranks. Bai–Gao–Li establishes an abelian-image theorem in characteristic zero, with hypotheses genuinely excluded by the new example. The previously published graded filiform Leibniz result concerns a different non-Lie multiplication; published free class-two Lie algebras also have different brackets. No prior inspected all-n finite-field rank census of this exact almost-Abelian filiform Lie family. Best-of-knowledge originality, with residual possible general grading/projection classifications.
residual_risks: Complete primary text of the Bai–Gao–Li 2015 article and every later grading classification were not checked anew here; stronger modular projection results might cover the rank table.
Independent finite checks of n=3,4 at q=2 are not an infinite-dimensional or arbitrary-field proof.
